mapper.select: SELECT primary_key, contract_code, buss_number, seller_enterprise, seller_enterprise_code, seller_contract_code, seller_contact_name, purchaser, state, business_belong, enterprise_code FROM ${tableName} WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} AND contract_code = #{contractCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, contract_code, buss_number, seller_enterprise, seller_enterprise_code, seller_contract_code, seller_contact_name, purchaser, state, business_belong, enterprise_code) VALUES (#{model.feedbackCode}, #{model.contractCode}, #{model.bussNumber}, #{model.sellerEnterprise}, #{model.sellerEnterpriseCode}, #{model.sellerContractCode}, #{model.sellerContactName}, #{model.purchaser}, #{model.state}, #{model.businessBelong}, #{model.enterpriseCode})
